entry.summary:
In a step toward regulatory clarity for Bitcoin holders in China, a Shanghai court has issued an opinion stating that personal ownership of digital assets is not illegal under Chinese law.
Personal Bitcoin Ownership Legal
The opinion, articulated by Sun Jie, a judge at the Shanghai Songjiang People’s Court, was published on the official WeChat account of the Shanghai High People’s Court.
Sun emphasized that while individuals are permitted to own cryptocurrencies, business entities in China are still prohibited from engaging in cryptocurrency investments or token issuance without regulatory approval.

Gensler out, Ulbritch freed and new policy expected. DeFi tokens the biggest gainers on Trump victory. BTC & SOL hit cycle highs against ETH. SOL flips BNB for 4th largest crypto. DOGE flips XRP for 7th largest crypto. VC funding hits $860m in Oct, up 30% MoM. Swift, UBS, Chainlink tokenisation pilot a success. AI agents will give retail traders ‘an edge’. Arkham supports TON.

entry.title: BTC & Stocks ATH, FED decision today, PNUT hits $125M
entry.summary: ETH leads majors, ETH/BTC reverses 8%. Blackrock BTC ETF hits record $4.1bn volume. BTC was up 1900% in Trump’s first term. Regulation headwind now tailwind: Bernstein. Bitcoin may hit $100k by year-end: BitGet. Trump may pass Bitcoin Act: CoinShares. Uyeda may replace Gensler at SEC. Lummis backs BTC as National Reserve asset. Tether bridges $2bn to ETH network. ETH ICO investor transfers $39.4mm to Kraken. DeFi coins outperform, ENA proposes fee swap. JPM allows instant FX settlement on blockchain. BNB allows tokenisation platform. CryptoCom plans stablecoin in 2025. Arkham launches perp futures exchange. AVAX buys $52m tokens from Luna Foundation. DOGE flip over XRP only brief. WLFI fails to see bounce in funding after election.

entry.title: US Election Day, Large ETF outflows, FWOG hits $380M!
entry.summary: BTC ETF see largest outflows since May. BTC briefly dips below 68k, OI falls $2bn. BTC hashrate hits another ATH. MT Gox transfers $2.2bn BTC to 2 wallets. Crypto prediction markets favour Trump 63%. Major crypto firms launch stablecoin network. Semler Scientific bought $71m BTC in Q3. First UK pension fund buys $65m BTC ETF. Michigan Pension Fund buy ETH ETFs. ETH is Amazon 2.0: 21 Shares. Deutsche Telekom pilots BTC mining scheme. Tether denies plan for blockchain. Citi, Fidelity unveil tokenized FX swaps. Bitget introduces Bitget Pay. a16z send another $23m to crypto PAC. Binance & CZ attempt to squash SEC suit.

entry.title: BTC dips below $69K, Cobie’s Bullish message, GOAT rebounds above $500M
entry.summary: BTC falls below $69k as Trump’s odds fall. BTC volatility points to ±10% move on election. BTC to $50k if Harris, $80-90k if Trump: Bernstein. We are going to $100k BTC no matter what: Cobie. 21Shares applies for XRP ETF. Singapore pushes for RWA tokenisation rules. UBS launches tokenised fund on ETH. Circle explores issuing stablecoin in Hong Kong. Tether launches Dirham stablecoin on TON. $2.8bn of altcoin unlocks this month. Tron makes 2nd highest ever monthly revenue. SOL saw 120m active addresses last month. EIGEN hits lows as ETH researchers leave. Coinbase called out for zero listing fee claim. Binance earlier accused of wanting 15% for listings.
